description: Taumata Arowai, the New Zealand Water Services Authority, keeps the official public registers of drinking water supplies and of public wastewater networks, searchable in its Hinekōrako system. On 26 September 2026 the drinking water register returned 1,637 supplies, each with a supply ID, name, type (networked supply, water carrier service, self-supplied building, community drinking water station or linked supply) and the community served, filterable by region, territorial authority, public health unit and exemptions granted. The wastewater register returned 327 networks operated by councils, council-controlled organisations, government departments and the Defence Force, with population serviced, region, territorial authority and whether the entry is verified; a stormwater register with a limited range of information is described on the overview page, and the former Ministry of Health supply register up to 2021 remains viewable. The registers are free to search, under Crown copyright terms, with no export seen. Caveats: some supplies need not register until 2028, lapsed or withheld entries appear, wastewater details may be incomplete, and the stormwater register was not reached. Simulation uses: an inventory of water supplies and treatment networks with population served for exposure and outage impact studies, emergency water planning by community, and capacity planning under the national water services reform.
